verses.translation: Alleluia, a Psalm of Aggæus and Zacharias. Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Sion.

translations.ron: Laudă, Ierusalime, pe Domnul, laudă pe Dumnezeul tău, Sioane,

verses.translation: For he has strengthened the bars of thy gates; he has blessed thy children within thee.

translations.ron: Că a întărit stâlpii porţilor tale, a binecuvântat pe fiii tăi, în tine.

verses.translation: He makes thy borders peaceful, and fills thee with the flour of wheat.

translations.ron: Cel ce pune la hotarele tale pace şi cu fruntea grâului te-a săturat,

verses.translation: He sends his oracle to the earth: his word will run swiftly.

translations.ron: Cel ce trimite cuvântul Său pământului; repede aleargă cuvântul Lui;

verses.translation: He gives snow like wool: he scatters the mist like ashes.

translations.ron: Cel ce dă zăpada ca lâna, Cel ce presară negura ca cenuşa,

verses.translation: Casting forth his ice like morsels: who shall stand before his cold?

translations.ron: Cel ce aruncă gheaţa Lui, ca bucăţelele de pâine; gerul Lui cine-l va suferi?

verses.translation: He shall send out his word, and melt them: he shall blow with his wind, and the waters shall flow.

translations.ron: Va trimite cuvântul Lui şi le va topi; va sufla Duhul Lui şi vor curge apele.

verses.translation: He sends his word to Jacob, his ordinances and judgments to Israel.

translations.ron: Cel ce vesteşte cuvântul Său lui Iacob, îndreptările şi judecăţile Sale lui Israel.

verses.translation: He has not done so to any other nation; and he has not shewn them his judgments.

translations.ron: N-a făcut aşa oricărui neam şi judecările Sale nu le-a arătat lor.
